agency: City of Apache Junction City Clerk / Council

findings.statement: Signed Resolution 26-43 states that an electronic copy of the amended Chapter 17 ALPR text is accessible on the city website and is declared a public record. The city-clerk PDF includes an appended copy.

The resolution's scanned signature page records passage and signing on October 6, 2026 with mayoral signature and clerk attestation. The city's separate public-notices table lists October 8 for Resolution 26-43; the date discrepancy requires clarification.

The attached original page is headed Chapter 17: Automated License Plate Readers, identifies Article 17-1, and begins with purpose and definitions. This establishes the source of the printed chapter in the signed resolution attachment.

Attached Chapter 17 section 17-1-3 requires designated police access, credentials, incident/case numbers and named-supervisor authorization. Section 17-1-4 describes a 30-consecutive-calendar-day limit on specified ALPR data. These are written provisions, not a test of real settings.

The attached chapter addresses supervisor preapproval of sharing, monthly Police Department ALPR log/user audits, independent review of those audits by a city employee outside the department, and penalties for violating the chapter. No actual audit, sharing relationship or enforcement case is verified.

limitations: This city-hosted five-page original is a signed and clerk-attested resolution bearing the Chapter 17 attachment. The attached text has not yet been independently matched in full against the earlier Council agenda version. The legal-effective date, current system configuration, camera coordinates, actual sharing permissions and completed auditing remain unverified.
